statement: Repairing lesson metadata requires rechecking the underlying history, not assigning a state that merely satisfies the schema. A seed can describe a missing defence in the same commit that adds its regression test: Cejel freeze_supersession #1 described the uncovered SSH-envelope predicate, but e308f62 already added the trusted OpenPGP G fixture and recorded the mutation failure in merged PR #325. Verify the landed diff and ancestry before choosing awaiting-fix or a real anchor; tense and an empty anchors array do not establish current state. Keep evidence of a landed test distinct from a fresh successful test run, and keep a transport holding directory distinct from completed ingestion.

movesWhen.reason: This is an evidence-review practice for classifying lesson records against current landed history. No single corrective code commit can replace the per-record review or prove future classifications correct.
